description: Recolour one or more palette slots of a hosted style (e.g. {"water": "#0b2038", "roadMajor": "#8a6d3b"}) and publish the result as a new immutable style version. Slot names come from list_style_layers; colours are CSS (#rgb/#rrggbb/#rrggbbaa/rgb()/hsl()). Returns the new version and style URL.

colours.description:
Palette overrides: slot name → CSS colour (e.g.
{"water": "#0b2038"}). Call `list_style_layers` for the slot names.

name: set_palette

style_url.description: Immutable URL of the compiled style at this version.
